before.source:
You breathe fire in a frontal cone of radius %d. Any target caught in the area will take %0.2f fire damage over 3 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Strength and the critical chance is based on your Mental crit rate.
		Each point in fire drake talents also increases your fire resistance by 1%%.
before.target:
你在前方 %d 码锥形范围内喷出火焰。此范围内的目标会在 3 回合内受到 %0.2f 火焰伤害。
		伤害受力量值加成，暴击几率基于你的精神暴击率。
		每点火龙系的技能可以使你增加火焰抗性 1%%。

radius.origin: T_FIRE_BREATH.radius computes the talent radius with combatTalentScale and a cap of 13.

damage.origin: t.getDamage(self,t) always computes Strength-based combatTalentStatDamage and adds Willpower-based combatTalentStatDamage only when Chromatic Fury is known.
damage.tooltip: info sends the uncritted getDamage scalar through damDesc(self, DamageType.FIRE, ...) and binds the result to %0.2f.
damage.action_crit: action sends getDamage through self:mindCrit, whose chance comes from combatMindCrit, before constructing the FIREBURN table.
damage.action_projection: the frontal cone project call receives DamageType.FIREBURN and {dam=mindCrit(getDamage), dur=3}.
damage.displayed_quantity: the uncritted tooltip FIRE-adjusted complete FIREBURN event amount, not a per-turn amount
damage.runtime_quantity: the potentially Mental-critical complete FIREBURN event amount before downstream mitigation
damage.conditional_willpower_qualification: Chromatic Fury Willpower scaling is an upstream conditional included in getDamage but absent from the frozen English; no unconditional Willpower wording is added to Chinese.

explicit_table_fireburn.incoming_total: D = action table dam after mindCrit(getDamage)
explicit_table_fireburn.immediate_damage: D * 50 / 100 = D/2 projected immediately as FIRE
explicit_table_fireburn.burning_power: (D/2) / 3 = D/6 per timeout for an isolated, unmerged application before downstream mitigation
explicit_table_fireburn.isolated_nominal_total: D/2 immediate plus the isolated three-turn BURNING remainder D/2 equals D
explicit_table_fireburn.complete_total_interpretation: D is the complete event total supplied to FIREBURN; it is not the amount of each BURNING timeout.

burning_merge_qualification.condition: the target already has EFF_BURNING and on_merge runs
burning_merge_qualification.qualification: The incoming remaining total is pooled with the existing remaining total and redistributed; no unconditional isolated three-timeout schedule is claimed after merge.
